# Generation and scenarios

`game.generation` exposes how maps and worlds are generated: terrain data, generation steps, features, rivers, roads, and base generation on a rectangle. `game.scenarios` reads the scenario of the running game and the game rules. The kits are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md).

`base_gen` runs a base generation symbol such as `basePart_outdoors` or `ancientRuins` on a rectangle of the map, the same machinery the game uses for ruins and bases.

```lua
local map = game.maps.current()
local c = game.things.info(colonist)
game.generation.base_gen(map, "ancientRuins", c.x + 10, c.z + 10, c.x + 22, c.z + 20)
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.generation.terrains` |  | `RimTerrainInfo[]` | Every terrain def with fertility and path cost. |
| `game.generation.map_generators` |  | `string[]` | Every map generator def name. |
| `game.generation.map_steps` | `generator?` | `RimGenStep[]` | Map generation steps, in order, optionally of one generator. |
| `game.generation.world_steps` |  | `RimGenStep[]` | World generation steps. |
| `game.generation.features` |  | `RimWorldFeature[]` | Named world features (mountain ranges, seas). |
| `game.generation.rivers` |  | `string[]` | Every river def. |
| `game.generation.roads` |  | `string[]` | Every road def. |
| `game.generation.base_gen` | `map, symbol, x, z, x2, z2, opts?` | `boolean` | Runs a base generation symbol (basePart_outdoors, ancientRuins, settlement, ...) on a rectangle. |
| `game.scenarios.list` |  | `RimScenarioInfo[]` | Every scenario def. |
| `game.scenarios.current` |  | `RimCurrentScenario` | The scenario of the running game with its parts. |
| `game.scenarios.part_defs` |  | `RimScenPartDef[]` | Every scenario part def. |
| `game.scenarios.disallowed_buildings` |  | `string[]` | Buildings the game rules forbid. |
| `game.scenarios.set_building_allowed` | `def, allowed` | `boolean` | Allows or forbids a building in the game rules. |
